claude.rationale: This was structured as a whole-company cash merger in which Merger Sub merged into the company, with the company surviving intact as a wholly owned subsidiary — legal vehicle, name, and self-described owner-operator-franchisor business model/product continued 1-1, and the entire operating substrate crossed the ownership boundary together rather than as a carve-out. Because the customer-facing restaurant/franchise product (T4) and its operating processes (T5) moved together as one intact company, gap_45 is 0; likewise the processes (T5) and the people/operations (T6) transferred together within the same surviving entity, so gap_56 is 0. The proxy explicitly notes no transition-services or shared-substrate bridging agreement was needed because the whole company, not a carved-out tier, crossed the boundary. T6 is coded partial and T1 replace because the entire pre-merger board was replaced by Merger Sub's directors at closing and the CEO was mid-succession-search and excluded from retention arrangements, indicating a new controlling intent installed while most executives/employees were retained.
